format: individual Jersey Mike's Franchised Restaurant in a retail shopping center (approx. 1,000 to 2,000 sq ft; excludes non-traditional, standalone and drive-thru)

invest.quote: The total initial investment necessary to begin operation of an individual Jersey Mike's Franchised Restaurant ranges from $436,176 to $1,162,228. This includes $47,250 to $49,250 that you must pay to Company.

fee.quote: In addition to the development fee, an initial franchise fee of $20,000 is payable in lump sum and due each time you sign a Franchise Agreement pursuant to an Area Development Agreement.
fee.note: An Area Development Agreement is always required, with a non-refundable development fee of $10,000 per Restaurant that is not applied toward the initial franchise fee (so $30,000 per Restaurant in total). Grand Opening Advertising fee of $10,000 also paid to Company at signing. In fiscal 2025 a reduced initial franchise fee of $8,500 was charged to certain existing franchisees acquiring rights to additional Restaurants.

royalty.quote: Continuing Royalty Fees 6.5% of Gross Receipts Payable weekly via wire transfer.

adFund.quote: Corporate Advertising and Development Fund Currently 1% of Gross Receipts ... National Media Fund 4% of Gross Receipts ... Your total payments to the Corporate Advertising Fund and the National Media Fund will not exceed 6% of Gross Receipts.
adFund.note: Currently 1% Corporate Advertising and Development Fund + 4% National Media Fund = 5%; combined cap 6% of Gross Receipts.

otherRecurring.name: POS Software License Fee and Support Package
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $395/month, but may increase up to $795/month

otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $0.2921 per transaction and 3.74% of the sale of each such transaction

otherRecurring.amount: $6.00 to $9.00 per small-order delivery, and $29 to $41 per large-order delivery

item19.note: Sales only (Unit Volume, net of sales taxes, refunds, discounts, coupons and donations); no costs or profits. Excludes 583 Restaurants open fewer than 361 days, 8 not on the designated POS, 13 Non-Traditional, and 17 owned or managed by Company, affiliates or Item 2 persons. 1,148 (44%) met or exceeded the average.

special: An Area Development Agreement with a $10,000 non-creditable development fee per Restaurant is mandatory even for one Restaurant. Company-Owned outlets are owned by affiliates (Company owns none); 8 former affiliate outlets were reclassified as franchised for 2025 after the Blackstone acquisition. Fund contributions may each be increased up to 6% of Gross Receipts, combined cap 6%.
issues: Cover does not say whether real estate is excluded (Item 7 covers leased premises only: rent deposits and leasehold improvements, no land or building purchase). Fee field shows the $20,000 franchise fee only; the mandatory $10,000 development fee comes on top.
